subject: FINAL HANDOFF ticket04: terminal exact-no-op still fails for queued Gen4 route, in-flight wake, and stale mirror-open
body: Canonical ticket04 Research completed two cycles on current main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64. Cycle 1 independently confirms wake is generation-fenced pre-Binder but WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY is shell-lineage-free, and ensureMirrorSession completion is only destruction/connection-fenced. Cycle 2 materially corrects peer corroboration: Gen4 serviceEpoch+intentSequence guarantees eventual ordering only if the newer terminal intent is admitted first; because commands execute on one coverMutationExecutor and admission occurs on execution, an old reassert queued first can execute after Samsung reaches native cover, pass owner/intent checks, perform physical/logical route mutation, and only then let the newer terminal return normalize to NATIVE_COVER. Thus final-native-cover 2/2 is not an adequate exact-no-op oracle. Deterministic model reproduces 1 physical + 1 route mutation in this ordering and zero with a daemon native-topology fence. Capture/presentation local stale fencing is stronger; geometry overlay is NOT_FOCUSABLE|NOT_TOUCHABLE, but native input/focus recovery remains current-build FIELD_BLOCKED. Required fix boundary: daemon nativeCover guard before physical gain/hold and again after blocking wake before route activation; app active-close-cycle/state fences; shell-verifiable wake intent lineage; mirror open generation/demand fencing with stale-session release. No production writes.
peer_reconciliation: ACCEPT wake/mirror corroboration; REJECT Gen4 final-state-as-exact-noop conclusion because FIFO old-work-first mutation is still legal and historical field evidence demonstrates the semantic shape.
